title: MMA: the greats overview
d: The greatest MMA players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
definition: The greatest MMA players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
description: The pantheon of MMA is argued in every bar and barbershop, but the names in this database appear on every serious list: champions who won the biggest prizes, record-setters whose numbers still stand, and pioneers who changed how MMA is played. Greatness here is measured three ways — winning, statistics, and influence — and the truest greats score on all three. Study them not to worship but to learn: every great was once a beginner who mastered fundamentals.

title: Anderson Silva
d: Anderson Silva (2000-2020): 10 title defenses; the Spider.
definition: Anderson Silva (2000-2020): 10 title defenses; the Spider.
description: Anderson Silva competed at the top of MMA from 2000-2020, and the achievement that defines the career is this: 10 title defenses; the Spider. What separated Anderson Silva was not one skill but the complete package — technique hardened by repetition, tactics sharpened by study, and the temperament to deliver when everything is on the line. Young players should study not just the highlights but the habits: the training volume, the professionalism, and the longevity that turned talent into legacy.
